Package com.agrialert.data_manager

Class Field

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.data_manager.Field
public class Field extends Object
Represents a geographical field entity within the data management system.

This class is a Room entity that stores information about a specific field, including its physical location (address, latitude, and longitude), the type of crop currently planted, and its association with a specific FieldsGroup.

It maintains a foreign key relationship with the FieldsGroup table, where deleting a group will reset the associated fields to a default group.

    • longitude

      private Double longitude
      The geographic longitude coordinate of the field.

    • groupName

      private String groupName
      The name of the group to which this field belongs. This acts as a foreign key linking to the FieldsGroup entity and defaults to "default" if the referenced group is deleted. Note that the default group will always exists at time of creation of the db an cannot be deleted.

    • cropType

      private CropType cropType
      The type of crop currently planted or associated with this field. NONE for fields without crops.
